# API reference

Generated from the typed stubs in `sdk/` — the public contract of the engine. Game code
imports `parallax` (the core), its plugin modules, and the project's generated `project`
module. A plugin module's names exist in a game only when `Game(plugins=[...])` includes
that plugin (see [`parallax.plugins`](parallax.plugins.md)).

Regenerate after changing a stub: `python3 tools/gen_api_docs.py`.

| Module | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`parallax`](parallax.md) | Parallax SDK — the public authoring API for games that run on ParallaxEngine. |
| [`parallax.plugins`](parallax.plugins.md) | Plugin constructors. |
| [`project`](project.md) | The `project` module is GENERATED by `parallax check` from the project's data files. |
| [`parallax.test`](parallax.test.md) | Headless, deterministic playtests (fixed seed, fixed timestep). |
| [`parallax.ai`](parallax.ai.md) | Game AI (plugins.ai()): behavior trees and blackboards, perception, squads and tactics, a combat director, RTS orders, flocks, and fog of war. |
| [`parallax.characters`](parallax.characters.md) | Characters plugin: one Character component for anything that walks (players, NPCs). |
| [`parallax.chat`](parallax.chat.md) | Text chat (plugins.chat()). |
| [`parallax.cinematics`](parallax.cinematics.md) | Cinematics (plugins.cinematics(skip=Controls.skip, advance=Controls.confirm)): cutscenes authored as data. |
| [`parallax.city`](parallax.city.md) | Procedural cities (plugins.city()): a whole city from one scene block — streets with lanes, markings and signals, blocks with sidewalks, buildings by district with facades and enterable ground floors, parks, plazas, landmarks and a far skyline — with ambient traffic and pedestrians. |
| [`parallax.combat`](parallax.combat.md) | Combat plugin: health, damage, death, sides, status effects, projectiles. |
| [`parallax.destruction`](parallax.destruction.md) | Destruction plugin (physics3d): breakable objects and impact damage. |
| [`parallax.economy`](parallax.economy.md) | Economy (plugins.economy()): what games trade, carry and find. |
| [`parallax.foliage`](parallax.foliage.md) | Foliage plugin: scattered trees, bushes, plants, rocks and models, and grass, declared on the scene (`"foliage": {"layers": [...]}` in scene.json). |
| [`parallax.grid`](parallax.grid.md) | Grid plugin: boards, tile maps and anything laid out in cells. |
| [`parallax.hud`](parallax.hud.md) | HUD kit (plugins.hud()): minimap, compass, crosshair, nameplates and world health bars, objective markers and pings, stat bars, ability bar, combo counter, key hints, awareness meters and damage arcs, and screen juice (hurt flash, low-health vignette, hit-stop, shake, eased slow motion). |
| [`parallax.interaction`](parallax.interaction.md) | Interaction (plugins.interaction(action=Controls.interact)): "[E] Open" prompts. |
| [`parallax.nav`](parallax.nav.md) | Navigation plugin: pathfinding agents over walkable surfaces on several levels (3D scenes). |
| [`parallax.net`](parallax.net.md) | Net plugin: server-authoritative online multiplayer. |
| [`parallax.payments`](parallax.payments.md) | In-game purchases (plugins.payments()), sold by the page or app hosting the game — the game never shows a pay button of its own or sees a card. |
| [`parallax.physics`](parallax.physics.md) | Physics (physics2d / physics3d plugins, Rapier). |
| [`parallax.procgen`](parallax.procgen.md) | Procedural geometry from data (plugins.procgen()): paths swept into roads, rails, coasters, pipes and race tracks; buildings from character-grid floor plans; seeded dungeons with locks and keys, dressed from prop kits. |
| [`parallax.save`](parallax.save.md) | Save plugin. |
| [`parallax.screens`](parallax.screens.md) | Panels on in-world screens (plugins.screens()): monitors, terminals, arcade cabinets, shop boards. |
| [`parallax.softbody`](parallax.softbody.md) | Cloth and soft bodies (plugins.softbody()): flags, capes, curtains, sails and banners; jelly, slime and balloons. |
| [`parallax.spawning`](parallax.spawning.md) | Spawning (plugins.spawning()): waves of spawns. |
| [`parallax.story`](parallax.story.md) | Story plugin (`plugins.story()`, `ctx.story`): facts, quests and dialogue. |
| [`parallax.terrain`](parallax.terrain.md) | Terrain plugin: heightfield ground declared on the scene (`"terrain": {...}` in scene.json). |
| [`parallax.values`](parallax.values.md) | Pure value types. |
| [`parallax.vehicles`](parallax.vehicles.md) | Vehicles plugin: cars, tracked vehicles, boats and arcade planes on Rapier. |
| [`parallax.viewmodel`](parallax.viewmodel.md) | First-person viewmodel (`plugins.viewmodel()`): arms and a held item drawn over the world with their own field of view and near plane (they never clip into walls), moved by procedural layers instead of baked clips, because what they do answers what the player does this frame: |
| [`parallax.voice`](parallax.voice.md) | Proximity voice chat (plugins.voice()), for net games: every player hears the others from where their avatars stand — full within `near` meters, fading to silence at `far`, panned to the side they're on — over WebRTC audio (Opus, echo cancellation and noise suppression by the browser). |
| [`parallax.voxels`](parallax.voxels.md) | Voxels plugin: block worlds. |
| [`parallax.water`](parallax.water.md) | Water plugin: oceans, lakes, pools and rivers as data, with waves you can sample, things that float, and characters that swim (a Character's `swim` reads the same water). |
| [`parallax.weather`](parallax.weather.md) | Weather plugin: presets blended by a director — rain, snow, hail, fog, cloud, wind and lightning — and what they do to the look (the environment greys the sky, dims the sun, thickens fog; rain falls only where the sky isn't covered; surfaces get wet and snowy) and to play (`ctx.weather.friction`, `visibility`). |
| [`parallax.wind`](parallax.wind.md) | Wind plugin: one wind field for the scene (`"wind": {...}` in scene.json), shared by everything that moves with the air: foliage and grass sway, streaks and blown leaves, and gameplay (sails, drift, projectiles) through `ctx.wind`. |
